competition_status: User-granted solo bonus only; no pending competition victory claimed, no official competition rerun or submission modification.
data: Public Plotly AAPL CSV, SHA256 in data/SHA256SUMS. 506 bars; 2015 initialization excluded, 284 daily evaluation bars from 2016-01-04 through 2017-02-16. Not claimed unseen. SPY public endpoints failed.
method: Fixed parameters; lagged close signals; next-open execution; fractional long-only cash-funded positions; adverse 5bps slippage and 10bps fee on slipped notional on every fill; terminal liquidation at final close. Adjusted OHLC proxy used identically by all controls. Baseline is frozen reconstructed daily execution of the preserved dual-horizon signal, not a claim of a previously existing historical engine. Both cycles have byte-identical control ledgers.
limitations: Single asset, short historical window; adjusted prices are retrospective, original data vendor unverified; no untouched prospective evidence, formal significance or independent annual folds. Fixed-parameter chronological holdout only, not rolling model retraining; annual tables are attribution, not separate trials. Both variants lag buy-and-hold. Drawdowns are daily close-marked and can understate intraday/overnight risk. No dividends/corporate-action cash ledger, market impact, taxes, cash interest, exchange-calendar completeness guarantee or live feasibility claim. Cycle2 sizing was predeclared, but the same sample had already been seen in cycle1. Failed data acquisitions are preserved in provenance rather than represented as simulations.
recommendation: Hysteresis merits independent validation; volatility sizing only merits risk-budget validation, not promotion as return improvement. Exactly two cycles complete; no more experimentation.
artifacts: Each experiment has Main.hs, hypothesis.json, findings.json, summary.csv and per-strategy trades/daily/annual CSVs; shared source common/Engine.hs, preserved baseline snapshot, public-data provenance/hash, and post-run reconciliation.csv.
